candidate_recipe.scope: Candidate numerical-stability recipe on six deliberately selected failed development cases; not a recognition-performance milestone or independent generalization estimate

report_recommendation.reason: H3 passes all six cases; H1 and H2 at the original learning rate do not.
report_recommendation.untested_comparison: H1 plus the lower learning rate was not tested; this result does not establish that it would be worse.

raw_data_policy: Raw matrices, annotations and retained numeric data stay at their original paths; no copies or deletions
scope: All input/head traces, checkpoints, acceptance failures, predictions and plots plus independently derived report frozen in place; one source/config/environment/decision snapshot
